messages.snippet: Dear Jonathan, Please find attached our first draft of the share purchase agreement for Project Will
messages.subject: Project Willow - first draft SPA
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Jonathan,

Please find attached our first draft of the share purchase agreement for Project Willow. As you'll see it reflects the agreed heads of terms. The buyer's position on the general warranty cap is 50% of the consideration; we look forward to your mark-up.

Kind regards,
James Osei
